title: Repair 2-panel training curves (unlabelled CI band, text overlap, wrong crossing epoch)
what: True crossover epoch (6), final cosine_warmup accuracy (%), or final accuracy gain (pts)

reader_questions.question: At which epoch does cosine_warmup overtake baseline_sgd?
reader_questions.expected: At epoch 6 (well before epoch 25, not epoch 42).

reader_questions.question: What do the shaded bands show and are the final curves separated beyond spread?
reader_questions.expected: Bands show ±1 s.d.; by epoch 25 cosine_warmup leads by +5.4 pts (89.0% vs 83.7%), cleanly outside ±0.6 pt s.d.

reader_questions.question: How does cosine_warmup behave during the earliest epochs?
reader_questions.expected: It starts with higher loss / lower accuracy during early warmup (epochs 1–5) before overtaking and finishing clearly ahead.
